id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

purchaseOrderLineId.description:
A unique identifier of this purchase order line. This should be used for display purposes in the UI.
**NOTE**: This is different {#id} of this purchase order line, which is system generated.

purchaseOrder.description:
{@link PurchaseOrder} to which this purchase order line belongs to.
Every purchase order line must belong to one and only one parent purchase order.

item.description:
The item that is being ordered as part of this purchase order line.
{#supplier} for this purchase order line and {#item} must match.

quantity.description: The quantity of the {#item} being ordered as part of this purchase order line.

requestedDeliveryDate.description: The date and time at which this order line has been requested to be received at the time of placing the order.

expectedDeliveryDate.description: The date and time at which this order line is expected to be delivered.

cost.description:
Amount of this purchase order line.
It should be equal to {#item}'cost multiplied by the {#quantity}'s value.

For example, if a cost of valve is 200 USD and 5 valves are being ordered in this line,
then the cost is 1000 USD for this order line.

receipts.description:
The {@link PurchaseOrderLineReceipt}s generated for every delivery received as part of this order line.
The receipts are ordered in descending order of time they are generated. This implies that the first item
in this list is the receipt corresponding to the last receipt of delivery.

quantityReceived.description:
The quantity of the {#item} received so far.
Obtained by summing all {@link PurchaseOrderLineReceipt#deliveredQuantity} generated so far against this order line.

fullyDelivered.description:
Indicator if the order line has been completely received.
This is true when {#quantity} is equal to {#quantityReceived}.

fulfillmentDate.description:
The final date at which the order line has been completely received.
It is the latest `deliveredDate` in the #receipts list.

supplier.description:
Name of the supplier who will be fulfilling this purchase order line.
Deduced from the parent {@link PurchaseOrder#supplier}.

purchaseDate.description:
The purchase date for this order line.
Deduced from the parent {@link PurchaseOrder#purchaseDate}.

title:
A purchase order line item is represents one of the items ordered by a buyer from a supplier as part of a purchase order.See {@link PurchaseOrder} for more details.
Each order line can have one or more receipts, which correspond to each shipment when the supplier delivers for this order line. See {@link PurchaseOrderLineReceipt}s for more details.
name: PurchaseOrderLine
